title: crataegus oxyacantha var. apiifolia
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha var. apiifolia, commonly known as Hawthorn apiifolia, is a variety of the hawthorn plant, which is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Hawthorn apiifolia include its ability to help alleviate symptoms of heart failure, lower blood pressure, and improve circulation. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a cardiotonic, improving cardiac output, and reducing cardiac workload. The bioactive constituents of Hawthorn apiifolia include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and triterpenoids, which contribute to its cardiovascular-protective and antioxidant properties.
